Top right: the reference's single cyan pulse revolver, pointing upward-right, steel and charcoal frame, cyan energy barrel and small brown grip. Bottom left: the reference's single red energy dagger, diagonal point down-left, red blade and dark handle up-right, no surrounding aura. Bottom right: the reference's thick gold-rim cyan bounty chip with a crisp cyan cowboy silhouette in its dark cyan center, no text. No lettering anywhere. Every icon is separate, all four outer silhouettes fit well inside their equal quadrants with 12% safety margin.
